titleEn: Smallest Missing Genetic Value in Each Subtree
title: 每棵子树内缺失的最小基因值
summary: 树节点基因值互不相同，返回每个节点子树中未出现的最小正整数。
insight: 若子树不含基因一，答案必为一，所以只有值一节点到根的祖先链需要计算。沿这条链向上，每步 DFS 新纳入的旁支节点并标记基因值，维护从一递增的最小未见值。
pitfalls: 已处理子树不能重复遍历
没有值一时所有答案均一

solutions.title: 值一到根路径增量 DFS
solutions.idea: 只为可能改变答案的祖先逐步扩大已见集合。
steps: answer 全一，定位 nums[node]==1；不存在直接返回
从该节点沿 parent 到根，每层 DFS 尚未访问的整棵子树并标记基因
递增 missing 至未见值，赋给当前祖先

code.java: class Solution { List<Integer>[] children;int[] nums;boolean[] visited,seen;private void add(int node){if(visited[node])return;visited[node]=true;if(nums[node]<seen.length)seen[nums[node]]=true;for(int child:children[node])add(child);}public int[] smallestMissingValueSubtree(int[] parents,int[] nums){int n=parents.length;this.nums=nums;children=new List[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)children[i]=new ArrayList<>();int one=-1,maximum=1;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){if(i>0)children[parents[i]].add(i);if(nums[i]==1)one=i;maximum=Math.max(maximum,nums[i]);}int[] answer=new int[n];Arrays.fill(answer,1);if(one<0)return answer;visited=new boolean[n];seen=new boolean[maximum+n+2];int missing=1;for(int node=one;node!=-1;node=parents[node]){add(node);while(seen[missing])missing++;answer[node]=missing;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private lateinit var children:Array<MutableList<Int>>;private lateinit var nums:IntArray;private lateinit var visited:BooleanArray;private lateinit var seen:BooleanArray;private fun add(node:Int){if(visited[node])return;visited[node]=true;if(nums[node]<seen.size)seen[nums[node]]=true;for(child in children[node])add(child)};fun smallestMissingValueSubtree(parents:IntArray,nums:IntArray):IntArray{this.nums=nums;val n=parents.size;children=Array(n){mutableListOf()};var one=-1;for(i in parents.indices){if(i>0)children[parents[i]].add(i);if(nums[i]==1)one=i};val answer=IntArray(n){1};if(one<0)return answer;visited=BooleanArray(n);seen=BooleanArray((nums.maxOrNull()?:1)+n+2);var missing=1;var node=one;while(node!=-1){add(node);while(seen[missing])missing++;answer[node]=missing;node=parents[node]};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<vector<int>> children;vector<int> nums;vector<bool> visited,seen;void add(int node){if(visited[node])return;visited[node]=true;if(nums[node]<(int)seen.size())seen[nums[node]]=true;for(int child:children[node])add(child);}public: vector<int> smallestMissingValueSubtree(vector<int>& parents,vector<int>& values){int n=parents.size(),one=-1,maximum=1;nums=values;children.resize(n);for(int i=0;i<n;++i){if(i)children[parents[i]].push_back(i);if(nums[i]==1)one=i;maximum=max(maximum,nums[i]);}vector<int> answer(n,1);if(one<0)return answer;visited.assign(n,false);seen.assign(maximum+n+2,false);int missing=1;for(int node=one;node!=-1;node=parents[node]){add(node);while(seen[missing])++missing;answer[node]=missing;}return answer;} };
